description: Möbler som förvaltas av Gator och parker, Umeå kommun is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Umeå kommun. Parkmöbler i Umeå kommun som ägs och sköts av Gator och parker. Coverage: Umeå kommun. The publisher named on the listing is Umeå kommun. Its keywords include Soffa, Umeå kommun, Picknickbord, Stol, Bord, Parksoffa. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, KML, GPX+XML, OCTET. The listing shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.sv). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
